# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.51

Changes since version [0.0.50](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/releases/tag/v0.0.50).

## Added

- X-Ray previews text files in the opposite pane with syntax highlighting and a complete minimap. The eye button cycles through off, preview on click, and X-Ray Ultra on hover after 200 ms. Right-clicking the eye turns the preview off.
- Preview text can be selected and copied with Ctrl+C or the context menu. Double-clicking a text line opens the original file at that line in VS Code. The line under the pointer receives a subtle background highlight.
- The preview receives 80% of the width. Its source list temporarily shows only filenames and icons. Turning X-Ray off restores the previous layout and columns.
- The maximum preview file size defaults to 5 MiB and can be changed in Settings with `bitfroest.files.xrayMaxFileSizeMiB`.

## Improved

- Pane footers place controls on the left and file counts, folder counts and size on the right.
- Two walkthroughs demonstrate X-Ray and X-Ray Ultra.

## Fixed

- X-Ray can be activated with a mouse click after switching focus between panes.
- Right-clicking a pane footer no longer opens a file context menu.

## Known limitations

- X-Ray reads the complete file. Archives, archive entries and binary content are excluded. Content detection is heuristic.
- Syntax highlighting covers JSON, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, XML, YAML, shell scripts and Markdown; other files appear as plain text. Extremely long lines retain Monaco’s tokenization safeguards. Installed VS Code language extensions and custom token themes are not automatically reused.
- Native showcase captures cover Windows with a dark theme. Other platforms and themes have no native visual acceptance for this feature.
- No settings migration is required.
